The designer should add a note clarifying that the dimension applies before plating (or after, with adjusted limits).","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'DIMENSIONS APPLY BEFORE PLATING' or adjust the toleranced size on D1 to account for the specified I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
